newsitem.title: FRANCE: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde May 16.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde May 16.

text.p: These are leading stories in afternoon daily Le Monde.
-- Socialist party leaders seek to revive campaign for upcoming parliamentary election by alleging corruption at the Paris mayor's office run by members of the ruling centre-right majority.
-- Unions at railway operator SNCF call for an end to a traffic controllers' strike over which meetings are to be held today.
-- Court fines retail group Carrefour for using a brand name of competitor Leclerc.
-- Banks and representatives of small and medium-sized businesses sign agreement to improve relationships.
